title: Skip repeated work events when locating a restored snapshot's first completion report
outcome: Historical restored acceptance-basis reads retain the correct installed layer without rescanning repeated same-revision events
acceptance: A historical restored-item basis read finds the original layer with work bounded by distinct revisions, even when the later portion of the feed contains many same-revision notes or gates.
A behavioral cost regression grows same-revision work events and verifies the read cost and correct original token both with and without a later completion report.
